# Deque Systems

> Deque Systems provides comprehensive web and mobile accessibility solutions through the Axe platform, professional services, and training to help organizations achieve WCAG compliance and reduce legal risk.

Deque is a leading provider of digital accessibility software and services, offering both automated testing tools and expert consulting to help enterprises build accessible digital experiences. The company serves organizations across various industries with products, services, and training programs designed to integrate accessibility into development workflows.

## Key Topics

- Axe Platform
- Axe DevTools
- Automated accessibility testing
- WCAG compliance
- Web accessibility
- Digital accessibility
- Accessibility audits
- CI/CD integration
- Axe MCP Server
- Accessibility training
- Compliance monitoring
- Remediation guidance
- IDE integration
- Accessibility consulting
- Deque University

## Axe Platform & Products

- [Axe Platform](https://www.deque.com/axe): Axe Platform overview featuring automated testing and compliance tools
- [Axe DevTools](https://www.deque.com/axe/devtools): Axe DevTools automated testing toolkit for web and mobile platforms
- [Axe DevTools Extension](https://www.deque.com/axe/devtools/extension): Axe DevTools browser extension for automated accessibility testing
- [Axe DevTools Linter](https://www.deque.com/axe/devtools/linter): Axe DevTools Linter for real-time accessibility feedback in IDE
- [Axe Monitor](https://www.deque.com/axe/monitor): Axe Monitor continuous accessibility scanning and compliance reporting
- [Axe Auditor](https://www.deque.com/axe/auditor): Axe Auditor product page for manual accessibility testing and audits
- [Axe MCP Server](https://www.deque.com/axe/mcp-server): Axe MCP Server IDE integration with AI-guided accessibility remediation
- [Axe Assistant](https://www.deque.com/axe/assistant): Axe Assistant AI chatbot powered by accessibility knowledge base
